summary: Full backend (10/10) + frontend mobile-web smoke tests passed for AW139 Power Assurance Calculator. Validated worked chart example (TQ=101, OAT=15, PA=6000 -> max_itt=718.2, max_ng=96.8), single/dual engine logic, overall_pass AND-of-engines, margin sign correctness, near_limit flag, OAT/PA range validation (HTTP 400), op_limit_exceeded notes (>775/>102.4/>105), and /api/pac/history POST+GET round-trip (no _id leakage). Frontend: app loads on 390x844 viewport with screen-title visible, debounced auto-compute renders overall-verdict + per-engine cards with PASS/FAIL badges & margins, twin-engine-switch correctly hides Engine 2 inputs/results when off, reset-button clears inputs and restores results-placeholder, Procedure tab shows ITT/NG/TQ operational limit cards (775/102.4/105), all 10 procedure steps, and RFM Supplement 12 source/disclaimer text.
